tire_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

image_height = 720

# Camera's horizontal field of view

# Lag (in seconds) between sensing and when data becomes accessible
lag = 0

# Exposure time (in seconds) for each image
exposure_time = 0

# View camera images

gator = veh.Gator()
gator.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
gator.SetChassisFixed(False)
gator.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))

gator.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
gator.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

gator.Initialize()

gator.SetChassisVisualizationType(chassis_vis_type)
gator.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(suspension_vis_type)
gator.SetSteeringVisualizationType(steering_vis_type)
gator.SetWheelVisualizationType(wheel_vis_type)
gator.SetTireVisualizationType(tire_vis_type)

# Print vehicle information

print("Driveline type: " + gator.GetVehicle().GetDriveline().GetTemplateName())
print("Brake type:     " + gator.GetVehicle().GetBrake(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())
print("Tire type:      " + gator.GetVehicle().GetTire(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())
print("\n")

# Set collision system type
gator.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# ------------------
# Create the terrain
# ------------------

patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 1.0))
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 50, 50)
terrain.Initialize()

box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5))
box.SetFixed(True)

    gator.GetChassisBody(),
    update_rate,
    offset_pose,
    image_width,
    image_height,
    fov
)
cam.SetName("Third Person POV")
# Renders the image at current point in the filter graph
cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(image_width, image_height, "Gator Camera"))
manager.AddSensor(cam)

# create lidar sensor
offset_pose = chrono.ChFramed(
        chrono.ChVector3d(0.0, 0, 2), chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(0, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0))

)
lidar.SetName("Lidar Sensor")

lidar.SetCollectionWindow(1/update_rate)

lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterPCfromDepth())

```python
import pychrono as pc
import numpy as np

# Initialize PyChrono environment and core components
pc.set_random_seed(12345)
sim = pc.Simulation()
dynamics_world = pc.DynamicsWorld()
sim.set_dynamics_world(dynamics_world)

# Add rigid terrain
terrain_shape = pc.BoxShape(100, 1, 100)
terrain_body = pc.RigidBody(terrain_shape)
terrain_body.set_position([0, -0.5, 0])
terrain_body.set_mass(0)
dynamics_world.add(terrain_body)

# Add Gator vehicle
gator_vehicle = pc.GatorVehicle()
gator_vehicle.set_position([0, 1, 0])
dynamics_world.add(gator_vehicle)

# Set vehicle parts visualization types
gator_vehicle.set_part_visualization_type("chassis", pc.VISUALIZATION_TYPE_MESH)
gator_vehicle.set_part_visualization_type("wheel", pc.VISUALIZATION_TYPE_MESH)
gator_vehicle.set_part_visualization_type("tire", pc.VISUALIZATION_TYPE_MESH)

# Add interactive driver system
driver = pc.Driver()
driver.set_vehicle(gator_vehicle)
dynamics_world.add(driver)

# Set up sensor manager with point lights and camera
sensor_manager = pc.SensorManager()
point_light = pc.PointLight()
point_light.set_position([0, 5, 0])
sensor_manager.add_light(point_light)

camera = pc.Camera()
camera.set_position([0, 3, -5])
camera.set_lookat([0, 1, 0])
sensor_manager.add_camera(camera)

# Add sensor manager to the simulation
sim.add(sensor_manager)

# Simulation loop
while sim.get_time() < 10:
    # Update driver, terrain, vehicle, and sensor manager
    driver.update()
    terrain_body.update_velocity()
    gator_vehicle.update()
    sensor_manager.update()

    # Synchronize and advance simulation modules
    sim.synchronize_modules()
    sim.advance()

    # Render camera images (uncomment if you want to save images)
    # camera.render_image("frame_{:04d}.png".format(int(sim.get_time())))

# Save the simulation to a file (optional)
sim.save("gator_vehicle_simulation.pcd")
```
